tickets.title: Enforce the ~2x total power growth cap
tickets.description: An ordinary bandit must still be able to kill a careless player in act three. This is what makes level-scaling unnecessary and keeps region tiers meaningful.

tickets.title: Capability unlock system: 30-40 discrete verbs, no ranks
tickets.description: 'You can pick locks of this class', not '+5% damage'. A rank is a delay pretending to be a choice.

tickets.title: Discovery XP from world generator scoring
tickets.description: Sites are already scored for remoteness and difficulty, so the reward tunes itself.

tickets.title: Milestone unlocks from quests, set pieces and faction ranks
tickets.description: Named unlocks rather than points. Keeps the quest layer load-bearing.

tickets.title: Trainer network gated by access and standing
tickets.description: Buy skills with coin and time from people who must be found and whose factions must tolerate you.

tickets.title: Per-Law progression meaning
tickets.description: Logistics, vitality, collection, cartography, conservation, debt ceiling. Hecatomb merges health and casting cost into one stat.

tickets.title: Expensive in-world respec service
tickets.description: Required in a generated world — a player cannot plan a build around content they have not seen. Costs money and travel.

tickets.title: Non-lethal failure states via the ledger
tickets.description: Lost cargo, standing, a companion, a route, or a week of world-clock time. What makes lethal combat bearable over sixty hours.

tickets.title: Cross-seed codex
tickets.description: Axioms encountered, synergies discovered, worlds forged, seeds completed. Informational and cosmetic only — nothing mechanical carries over.
